item.title: Show HN: OldHand A Claude/Codex plugin to verify the development flow end-to-end
item.summary: I built this clod code or codec skill because I just love using these AI agents to write code. It's just so convenient to do. But when it comes to working in a corporate environment, I have to ultimately follow a Jira ticket or a Asana ticket. Now, when I'm following those tickets, I am able to do the work, but it's not always up to the mark because after all I found AI to hallucinate, Unnecessary code is being written, even though a function for that is already there and can be reused, no proper testing apart from unit test being done so when the QA started testing it they raised a astronomical amount of bugs. So, with Claude and Codex becoming very capable especially with their plugins/connectors and computer use ability, I build OldHand that allows for end-to-end ticket development, planning, coding, reusability (combined with Ponytail), QA testing with browser/computer use. I would love to get people's feedback as it has been helping me a lot with my day-to-day work, but I would like to improve this even further and every feedback helps.
